description:
## Goal

Make the one retained InputFlowRelation preserve each direct-call argument frame atomically, including normalized local constants and exact origin-path operands. Relational semantic questions must substitute one real frame, never Cartesianize independent input columns or reconstruct information discarded by the relation.

## Proven defects

DirectCallFlow stores independent input columns. Coherent frames {(a,b),(c,d)} and crossed frames {(a,d),(c,b)} collapse to the same fact even though equality of the two callee inputs has different meaning. Local constants also disappear, so same(x, :hit) and same(x, :miss) retain equal relations.

The first correlated-frame implementation exposed a duplicate-authority defect: input_flow separately interpreted every LoweredStep variant and omitted lambda captures, dynamic bitstring sizes, and BitstringRead outputs. jobs/body.rs, jobs/artifact.rs, and executable_facts.rs also independently enumerate generic definitions or reads.

Cold review of the first shared-role candidate exposed two further laws:

- A fully overwritten map-update base correctly contributes no terms, but the resolver represented that as no alternative and annihilated the surviving replacement contribution.
- The universal role visitor eagerly ran repeated map suffix scans even for definition-only and read-only consumers, making a one-result query quadratic in literal entry count.

## Correct-by-construction model

LoweredStep owns one exhaustive typed value-role authority. Every variant and field is destructured without catch-all field patterns. Callers select one explicit interest:

- Definitions emits only zero to three result identities and enters no aggregate loop.
- Reads visits every raw evaluation or assertion operand exactly once, without classifying semantic contributions.
- Semantics emits definitions, normalized literals, typed structural or whole contributions, and control-local AssertSame equalities.

Thin definition/read adapters may call this authority; no consumer keeps another LoweredStep opcode inventory.

Map reads are one forward pass. Map semantic contributions are one right-to-left pass with one ordered set of normalized later-known LiteralDenotationRef values. Known last-writer, dynamic exclusion, and map-remainder meaning live in that pass. Input flow only copies the already normalized selector into its retained path. Classification costs O(n log n) set work plus E members that the retained exclusion lists necessarily emit. Definition-only queries perform zero operand visits and zero classifications; read-only queries visit n entries and classify zero; semantics classifies n entries.

The value-alternative algebra has three distinct values:

- no alternatives means impossible;
- one alternative with no terms is the no-contribution product identity and retains branch choices;
- one explicit opaque term is a conservatively unknown local value with its flattened exact operand atoms.

Projection or construction may filter every term without deleting its alternative or choices. Only incompatible choices remove a combination. Missing definitions become explicit opaque local values; an impossible set never falls back to unknown.

One DirectCallFlow owns a canonical set of complete call-input frames. Each frame is one real correlated alternative across all callee inputs; zero arguments is one empty frame. A slot retains exact typed origin or normalized LiteralDenotation atoms, or one flat opaque local term naming every exact operand it may read. No display text, source spelling, span, ValueId, ControlEntryId, Ty allocation order, or rendered type is retained as semantic identity.

Structural projection and construction reuse InputPathStep and compose_paths. Dynamic map selectors, exclusions, remainders, list, tuple, and bitstring paths do not gain a second walker. Control-flow choice markers exist only during extraction and are stripped from the retained fact.

Relational questions retain one normalized QuestionTemplate plus an operand tuple. Equality canonicalizes operand swap; ordering canonicalizes by swapping operands and reversing the operator; repeated-role aliasing is explicit. Literal substitution reduces to the exact unary question when possible.

The existing World InputFlow fact remains the sole authority. Equal normalized frame sets retain allocation and generation and wake nobody. Source replacement withdraws obsolete frames exactly.

## TDD

1. RED from the clean predecessor: literal and coherent-versus-crossed relations collapse. After the cutover both distinctions remain exact.
2. Capturing lambdas, constructed bitstrings, every BitstringRead output, and opaque local computations retain their exact origin and literal operands.
3. Multi-output definitions survive retained-value and artifact boundaries. Overwritten map values remain evaluation reads but are not semantic contributions.
4. RED on the first shared-role candidate: %{a: x} updated with a: y and passed to a callee loses y. The erased base is a no-term unit; y remains. A correlated branch variant preserves its choice evidence through full or partial overwrite and invents no frame.
5. Alternative algebra tests distinguish impossible, empty contribution, and opaque unknown. Missing slots alone use explicit unknown fallback.
6. Deterministic role-work counts prove: Definitions on an n-entry map visits/classifies 0 entries; Reads visits n and classifies 0; Semantics classifies n with n normalized-key set operations and reports exact emitted exclusion members.
7. Equality swap, ordering reversal, repeated operands, and literal substitution have canonical typed identities independent of mint or arrival order.
8. Two calls never cross-connect. Independent merges produce exactly real joint alternatives. Zero arguments produces one empty frame.
9. Branch, source, and job-order permutations reproduce byte-equal content. Equal publication retains allocation and revision and schedules no reader. Replacement retracts only obsolete frames.
10. The composition fixture drives dynamic bit size through constructed bits, a captured closure, and a direct call, asserting distinct size outcomes on interp, run, and build.

Every semantic defect witness must fail through the production boundary on the relevant predecessor before the model changes.

## Deletion and boundaries

Delete DirectCallFlow independent columns, the input_flow opcode match, duplicate generic result/read enumerators, map-specific literal identity, eager universal-role work, suffix scans, and helpers or tests that treat local constants as absence. Leave no frame side table, compatibility columns, second fact, display classifier, variant repair list, timing threshold, or proof-only probe.

Do not mechanically replace policy-specific semantic typing, codegen, or callable-escape analysis with generic reads. runtime_demand callable escape behavior requires its own production witness before any future convergence. Replacing ExprStep or introducing a macro-generated instruction schema is outside this ticket.

This ticket corrects the retained relation boundary landed by fz-kdt.214 and blocks fz-kdt.200. fz-kdt.200 owns the final finite joint question carrier, recursive solver, and activation cutover. fz-kdt.188 separately removes a fabricated Cartesian ActivationInputRow after semantic coalescing. Closed fz-kdt.81 and fz-1ah.8 cover different retained authorities.

## Acceptance

The retained relation distinguishes all falsifying witnesses. Generic definitions, reads, and semantic contributions come from one selective LoweredStep authority with deterministic causal work bounds. Empty contributions never annihilate live terms or branch evidence. Direct duplicate enumerators and repeated suffix scans are gone. The relation remains immutable, deterministic, replacement-aware, and allocation-retaining on equal reproduction.

Focused role, extraction, path, and question tests; serial library; serial fixture matrix; all three target doors; cross-process determinism; documentation checks; cargo check; strict clippy; formatting; and diff checks pass. A fresh ticket-scoped cold adversarial review accepts the final frozen diff before its one commit and close.
title: Preserve correlated semantic call frames in InputFlowRelation
